items.summary: Apertus is presented as an open foundation model for sovereign AI, with open weights, open data and open science from the Swiss AI Initiative.

items.title: Xiaohongshu said to prepare confidential Hong Kong IPO filing this month
items.raw_content: According to Bloomberg News, citing people familiar with the matter, Xiaohongshu is preparing to confidentially file for an initial public offering (IPO)
items.title_zh: 传 Xiaohongshu 本月准备秘密提交香港 IPO 申请
items.summary: Bloomberg News, citing people familiar with the matter, says Xiaohongshu is readying a confidential filing for a Hong Kong IPO.

items.title_zh: 福克斯将收购 Roku
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reports that Fox will buy Roku.

items.title: US holds off blacklisting DeepSeek, more than 100 firms deemed security risks
items.title_zh: 美国暂缓将 DeepSeek 列入黑名单，逾百家企业被认定存在安全风险
items.summary: The US reportedly held off on blacklisting DeepSeek, while more than 100 firms were deemed security risks, according to a Reuters report.

items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reports that Fox will buy Roku.

items.title: Apple Foundation Models
items.title_zh: Apple Foundation Models 框架
items.summary: Anthropic's documentation describes running Claude on Apple platforms through the Foundation Models framework using the Claude for Foundation Models Swift package.

items.title: Salesforce to Acquire Fin (formerly Intercom) for $3.6B
items.title_zh: Salesforce 将以 36 亿美元收购 Fin（原 Intercom）
items.summary: Salesforce has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Fin, formerly Intercom, for $3.6 billion, bringing Fin's customer agent platform to companies of all sizes.

items.title: Google Chrome update will close the door on ad blockers
items.title_zh: Google Chrome 更新将彻底关上广告拦截器的大门
items.summary: A report says an upcoming Google Chrome update will close the door on popular ad blockers, with related coverage noting a push to retire MV2 extensions for good.

items.title: GLM-5.2 is the new leading open weights model on Artificial Analysis
items.title_zh: GLM-5.2 成为 Artificial Analysis 上领先的开放权重模型
items.summary: Z.ai's GLM-5.2 tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 51, 11 points above GLM-5.1 at the same 744B total / 40B active size, and sits on the intelligence-versus-cost Pareto frontier ahead of MiniMax-M3 and DeepSeek V4 Pro (max), both at 44. First-party API pricing stays at $1.4/$4.4/$0.26 per 1M input/output/cache-hit tokens.

items.title: U.S. science is in chaos
items.title_zh: 美国科学界陷入混乱
items.summary: Scientific American reports that the interim head of the National Science Foundation announced his retirement in an internal memo with no immediate replacement named, as the agency reels from staff layoffs and funding cuts.

items.title: HPV vaccine cuts risk of dying from cervical cancer before 30
items.title_zh: HPV 疫苗降低 30 岁前死于宫颈癌的风险
items.summary: A study found that HPV vaccination cuts the risk of dying from cervical cancer before age 30, but experts cautioned that deaths and cases may rise again as fewer teenagers get vaccinated.

items.title: A new bill takes aim at government pressure to silence lawful online speech
items.title_zh: 新法案剑指政府施压压制合法网络言论
items.summary: Bipartisan legislation would create a federal cause of action against officials who coerce broadcasters, online services or AI providers over lawful, First-Amendment-protected speech, plus a transparency system for such communications.

items.title: Munich 1991: The Roots of the Current AI Boom
items.title_zh: 1991 年的慕尼黑：当前 AI 热潮的根源
items.summary: David Ha and Jürgen Schmidhuber trace today's AI boom to work published in 1991 at a single lab at the Technical University of Munich led by Schmidhuber, arguing that many core building blocks appeared within months.

items.title: DOS Game "F-15 Strike Eagle II" reversing project needs DOS test pilots
items.title_zh: DOS 游戏《F-15 Strike Eagle II》逆向工程招募 DOS 试飞员
items.summary: A hobby project that recreates the C source of the 1989 game F-15 Strike Eagle II by reverse engineering its original binaries is looking for DOS test pilots.

items.title: The Wholesale Plagiarism of Obscure Sorrows
items.title_zh: 《Obscure Sorrows》遭遇整本抄袭
items.summary: A marketing agency republished John Koenig's Dictionary of Obscure Sorrows in full without permission, replaced its art with AI-generated images and added AI-made words; its unauthorized site now ranks higher than the original everywhere, Waxy reports.

items.title: Good results fine tuning a local LLM like Qwen 3:0.6B to categorize questions
items.title_zh: 微调 Qwen 3:0.6B 这类本地模型做问题分类，效果不错
items.summary: A hobbyist reports good results fine-tuning a small local model such as Qwen 3:0.6B to sort household questions into metadata categories, so that metadata-aware vector search only ranks entries belonging to the matching category.

items.title: When I reject AI code even if it works
items.title_zh: 即便 AI 生成的代码能跑，我也会拒绝
items.summary: A developer essay argues that AI makes implementation cheap while making review and judgment more expensive, and describes the cases in which working AI-generated code is still rejected.

items.title: Ask HN: Has anyone replaced Claude/GPT with a local model for daily coding?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：有人把 Claude/GPT 换成本地模型做日常编程吗？
items.summary: A Hacker News user asks whether anyone has completely replaced Claude or GPT with a local model as their primary coding tool, and requests setup details and token-per-second figures from those who have.

items.title: Show HN: Gerrymandle - Daily puzzle game where you redraw electoral districts
items.title_zh: Show HN：Gerrymandle——重划选区的每日解谜游戏
items.summary: Gerrymandle is a daily puzzle game in which players draw electoral districts and try to win the election, with a new puzzle every day.

items.title: Hey, n00b, we didn't hire you to complete tasks
items.title_zh: 嘿，菜鸟，我们招你不是为了让你完成任务
items.summary: A newsletter essay tells new engineers that nobody cares how many tasks they complete, dividing new hires into people who make everyone more productive, solid performers, and those unlikely to last a year.

items.title: Xiaohongshu said to prepare confidential Hong Kong IPO filing this month
items.title_zh: 传 Xiaohongshu 本月准备秘密提交香港 IPO 申请
items.summary: Bloomberg News, citing people familiar with the matter, says Xiaohongshu is readying a confidential filing for a Hong Kong IPO.

items.title: Ant Group said to be preparing AI version of Alipay for public launch
items.title_zh: 传蚂蚁集团正筹备公开发布 AI 版支付宝
items.summary: Foreign media report that Ant Group is quietly testing an AI-powered version of Alipay, which is said to radically change the app.

items.title: Baidu’s Apollo Go begins Swiss road tests With PostBus autonomous service
items.title_zh: 百度 Apollo Go 携手 PostBus 在瑞士启动自动驾驶路测
items.summary: Baidu's Apollo Go, in partnership with Swiss public transport operator PostBus, has begun road testing its autonomous driving service.

items.title: Chinese game developer S-GAME delays Phantom Blade Zero to October 29
items.title_zh: 中国游戏开发商 S-GAME 将《Phantom Blade Zero》延期至 10 月 29 日
items.summary: Chinese developer S-GAME has delayed Phantom Blade Zero from September 9 to October 29, announcing the change during Sony's latest State of Play.

items.title: NIO CEO warns China auto market could decline 15%–20% in 2026
items.title_zh: 蔚来 CEO 警告：2026 年中国汽车市场可能下滑 15%–20%
items.summary: Speaking at the 2026 China Automotive Chongqing Forum, NIO CEO Li Bin warned the industry to prepare psychologically for a potential downturn and said the China auto market could decline 15%–20% in 2026.

items.title: Alipay introduces AI-powered Abao, taking an early lead in China’s super app AI race
items.title_zh: 支付宝推出 AI 助手 Abao，在中国超级 App AI 竞赛中抢先一步
items.summary: Alipay, which TechNode describes as China's leading mobile payments and super app platform, has launched its AI-powered assistant Abao and begun invitation-only testing.

items.title: Alibaba unveils Qwen-Robot series with three foundation models for embodied AI
items.title_zh: 阿里巴巴发布 Qwen-Robot 系列，推出三款面向具身智能的基础模型
items.summary: The Qwen team released a robotics suite with three foundation models — Qwen-RobotNav, Qwen-RobotManip and Qwen-RobotWorld — aimed at embodied AI, according to TechNode.

items.title: Ubisoft and Tencent launch first technical test for Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Siege China
items.title_zh: 育碧与腾讯启动《彩虹六号：围攻》中国区首次技术测试
items.summary: Developed by Ubisoft and published in China by Tencent, the tactical shooter Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege has launched its first technical test in the country.

items.title: Xiaomi releases MiMo Claw AI agent, raises free access to four hours daily
items.title_zh: 小米发布 MiMo Claw AI 智能体，每日免费时长提升至四小时
items.summary: Xiaomi's large model team launched MiMo Claw, a lightweight cloud-based AI agent powered by its flagship MiMo-V2.5-Pro model, and raised free access to four hours daily.

items.title: Kc1t/alethe-agents
items.title_zh: Kc1t/alethe-agents：本地优先的多编码代理桌面工作区
items.summary: A local-first desktop workspace for running, organizing and resuming multiple coding agents and shells, featuring real PTYs, split panes, persistent layouts and local session history; written in TypeScript.

items.title: anthropics/launch-your-agent
items.title_zh: anthropics/launch-your-agent：从想法到上线 Claude 托管智能体
items.summary: A set of Claude Code skills guides founders from an initial idea to a running Claude Managed Agent, covering interviews, v0 scoping, launch in their own account, grading, iteration, and scheduling.

items.title: Kato-Shoko705/Phoebe-Hub
items.title_zh: Kato-Shoko705/Phoebe-Hub：《鸣潮》菲比表情包收集站
items.summary: Phoebe-Hub is a JavaScript repository that stores a collection of sticker images of Phoebe, a character from the game Wuthering Waves.

items.title: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
items.title_zh: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
items.summary: Baidu's Unlimited-OCR is a Python project that advertises one-shot long-horizon parsing for OCR workloads.

items.title: Augani/dory
items.title_zh: dory：面向 Apple Silicon 的完整本地开发系统
items.summary: Dory is a Swift-based local development system for Apple Silicon that combines Docker, Compose, Kubernetes, virtual machines and policy-bound agent sandboxes.

items.title: sums001/Windows-Copilot-API
items.title_zh: Windows-Copilot-API：把 Windows Copilot 逆向成 OpenAI 兼容 API
items.summary: A Python project that reverse-engineers Windows Copilot into an OpenAI-compatible REST API, providing access to GPT-4 and GPT-5 models without API keys or billing.

items.title: yo-WASSUP/Good-Badminton
items.title_zh: yo-WASSUP/Good-Badminton：AI 羽毛球鹰眼系统
items.summary: An AI Badminton Hawk-Eye system written in Python.

items.title: p1neappleXpress/OpenFlux
items.title_zh: OpenFlux：支持可插拔传输的 TCP 隧道研究工具
items.summary: OpenFlux is a Go network-stack research tool that provides a TCP tunnel with pluggable transports.

items.title: latent-spaces/brag
items.title_zh: latent-spaces/brag：一条命令把项目变成发布视频
items.summary: With one command, the tool converts a project into a short launch video that can be shared.

items.title: ornith-ai/Ornith-1
items.title_zh: Ornith-1
items.summary: Ornith-1 is a repository from the ornith-ai organization that was trending on GitHub; the listing carried no description.

items.title: OTRO: Oblivious Tokenization Path with Square-Root ORAM
items.title_zh: OTRO：基于平方根 ORAM 的低开销不经意分词路径
items.summary: OTRO targets tokenizer access-pattern leakage in confidential LLM serving, using a pool of replicated square-root ORAM instances, epoch-based rotation and chunked KV-cache-aware tokenization; on Intel TDX with an NVIDIA H100 it limits time-to-first-token overhead to at most 4.5% while adding under 0.5 GB of memory.

items.title: Position: Explainability Research Must Prioritize Foundations over Ad-hoc Methods
items.title_zh: 立场：可解释性研究应优先关注基础而非临时方法
items.summary: This position paper argues that explainable AI research should move from ad-hoc methods to foundational problems such as unclear formulations, underspecified evaluation objectives, and missing pipelines for explanation-driven feedback. The authors base the case on an analysis of recent ICML, NeurIPS, and ICLR papers and a survey of XAI practitioners, and propose a practical checklist.

items.title: Distributed General-Purpose Agent Networks: Architecture, Key Mechanisms, and Prototypes
items.title_zh: 分布式通用智能体网络：架构、关键机制与原型
items.summary: The paper proposes a layered architecture for peer-to-peer networks of heterogeneous agents that discover one another, establish trust and execute open-ended tasks, covering semantic announcement propagation, verifiable identity with multi-topic reputation, and semantic-gradient mechanism design, with prototype and simulation results.

items.title: PSyGenTAB: A Privacy-Preserving Framework for Synthetic Clinical Tabular Data Generation via Constrained Optimization
items.title_zh: PSyGenTAB：通过约束优化生成隐私保护合成临床表格数据的框架
items.summary: PSyGenTAB formulates synthetic clinical tabular data generation as a constrained optimization problem solved with the Augmented Lagrangian Method, embedding configurable privacy constraints into training. The authors report that models trained on its synthetic data perform comparably to those trained on real records and show reduced exact record reproduction and resilience to membership inference attacks.

items.title: Generative Responsible AI Data Evaluation Schema (GRAIDES) for AI Assurance in Local Government
items.title_zh: GRAIDES：面向地方政府 AI 保障的生成式负责任 AI 数据评估模式
items.summary: GRAIDES is a lightweight open-source data model for centralizing AI observability across vendors, with blueprints for code, architecture, and statistical evaluation. A case study using Westminster City Council's AI catalogue focuses on measuring human-model alignment, including detecting systematic disagreement between evaluators.

items.title: Learning a Normal World Model for Few-Shot Boundary-Calibrated Abnormality Detection
items.title_zh: 学习正常世界模型，用于少样本边界校准的异常检测
items.summary: The paper learns a normal-world model from abundant normal events and uses a few abnormal examples only to calibrate the boundary of normality, implemented as a Hypergraph Entropic Normal-World Model; on the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan benchmark it reaches AUROC 0.9983 on FD004 and reports strong zero- and few-shot results.

items.title: moBERTo: A Modern Encoder for Portuguese via Continued Pretraining of ModernBERT
items.title_zh: moBERTo：继续预训练 ModernBERT 打造的葡萄牙语编码器
items.summary: moBERTo is a Portuguese adaptation of ModernBERT built by continued pretraining on 60 billion tokens while keeping the original architecture; its best variant posted the highest average reranking nDCG@10 across three Portuguese retrieval benchmarks and the best PLUE-PT results, and the weights and training data are released on Hugging Face.
